# Easy ADB v0.3.0

Easy ADB connects a Windows PC or Mac to Android phones, TVs and TV boxes. Use USB, wireless pairing, mDNS discovery, or reconnect to one of the last five wireless devices.

## Downloads and source

- Website: https://easyadb.panchan.top/
- Windows x64: https://github.com/Panda2Chan/easy-adb/releases/latest/download/EasyADB-Setup-x64.exe
- macOS Universal: https://github.com/Panda2Chan/easy-adb/releases/latest/download/easy-adb-mac-universal.zip
- Releases and installation notes: https://github.com/Panda2Chan/easy-adb/releases
- Public repository: https://github.com/Panda2Chan/easy-adb

## Features

- Inspect APK metadata, Android API and CPU compatibility before installing local files or HTTP(S) direct links.
- Install supported APKS and APK-only XAPK bundles. XAPK bundles with OBB expansion data are unsupported.
- Inspect installed packages and confirm removal of user apps.
- Read Chinese installation diagnostics, send up to 512 printable ASCII characters to a focused input, and check for updates.
